formal_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin m → Bool)), 0 < k → (∀ x : Fin m → Bool, x ∉ S → ∃ V : Finset (Fin m), V.card ≤ k ∧ ∀ y : Fin m → Bool, (∀ i ∈ V, y i = x i) → y ∉ S) → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i : Fin m, Function.update x i (!x i) ∉ S) → S.card ≤ 2 * k * 2 ^ (m - m / (2 * k))
plain_statement: KNOWN (Paturi, Pudlak, Zane, Satisfiability coding lemma, FOCS 1997, in a weaker integer form): a set S of points of the m-cube with no two neighbours, each of whose non-members is excluded by at most k coordinates (so S is the solution set of a CNF of width k), has at most 2k * 2^(m - m/(2k)) points. Stated without CNFs.
title: Isolated solutions of a width-k CNF on m variables number at most 2k * 2^(m - m/(2k))
